nyt_abstract: Visits to the International Space Station are valuable, and would-be astronauts and their countries can wait a long time for the opportunity. The three on the Ax-3 flight are: Alper Gezeravcı, who will be the first Turkish astronaut; Marcus Wandt, a European Space Agency astronaut from Sweden; and Walter Villadei, an Italian Air Force pilot who previously flew to the edge of space on a Virgin Galactic rocket plane. A launch on Wednesday was postponed to Thursday.
